^[Timoros]& Eu so precisava de mais um pouco de tempo.. So mais um pouco.. E eu poderia consertar o passado.. Minha mae estaria viva novamente!

^[Timoros]& Ele sempre recompensa devidamente aqueles que permanecem fieis.
^[Timoros]& Ele e diferente dos deuses.. Nao.. Ele e mil vezes melhor que os deuses.
^[Timoros]& Ele me deu esperanca quando eu havia perdido tudo!!
^[Timoros]& Ele e diferente de voce! Voce afirma que nada vai mudar mesmo se eu conseguir minha vinganca?!
^[Timoros]& Voce devia ter me dito isso ha 20 anos! Agora e tarde demais!!
|[Lucian]& Nao esperava que alguem viesse te impedir? Agora nao e tarde demais!
^[Calmon]& O odio esta profundamente enraizado nesta crianca.
^[Calmon]& {Lucian&, lute contra ela agora. As vezes, esse e o unico jeito de resolver as coisas.
^[Timoros]& Hahaha.. Sim.
^[Timoros]& Embora eu sempre ameace matar voces dois se ousarem entrar no meu caminho, eu torcia para que viessem me impedir.
^[Timoros]& Nao fui com a sua cara desde o comeco.
^[Timoros]& E quero matar voce pessoalmente!!

^[Alpez]& I am the beginning of all disasters and I am the end.
|[Lucian]& {Alpez&...
^[Alpez]& Do you want to know more? The {Giant God& let humans create the {Elementals to kill the {Protector& and release him.
^[Alpez]& In order to attain that kind of power, the {world has been recreated& numerous times.
^[Alpez]& {Lucian& was abandoned because of me. {Ian& and {Clare& fought to save this world, but their efforts have been in vain..
^[Alpez]& And that's because of me as well!!
^[Alpez]& This is all my fault. Nobody knew about it, so nobody can forgive me!

^[Calmon]& That's why you seemed so repelled by me?

^[Alpez]& .. Ok.
|[Lucian]& Where should we head to then?
^[Alpez]& The mountain in the middle of Spiegel Lake.. We can get there through the underground tunnel at the {Swamp&.

^[Alpez]& ...
^[Calmon]& You are trying to escape your fate.

^[Kratos]& Nao matter what, this girl has committed the worst crime in this world.

^[Kratos]& You heard about it in Humming City right? This is the girl who opened the box.
^[Kratos]& I survived because of this and lasted all these while.
^[Kratos]& If she had released everything in the box, we would still have a chance of starting over. But because of her, we are now trapped in this predicament.
^[Kratos]& Do you still want to save her now?
|[Lucian]& I can be my own judge.
|[Lucian]& I don't need you to tell me what to do!
^[Kratos]& How sad.. but I can't just walk away either.. O que devemos fazer?
^[Kratos]& I've given you so many opportunities yet still you seek death. Perhaps you should die here then.

^[Aquila]& Right about time. I am tired of waiting.
|[Lucian]& Stop acting. I already know everything from {Alpez&.
^[Aquila]& .. Alright, the {Giant God& has done some funny stuff too.
^[Aquila]& In order to avoid future problems, he created an even bigger one.
|[Lucian]& Why are you helping him? Why did you kill so many for something that's so meaningless?
^[Aquila]& Helping him? He is just doing what he wants to do, and I  am doing the same.
^[Aquila]& I am like the Elemental beside you. We are puppets that do someone else's biddings.
^[Aquila]& I can't do what that girl attempts to do, kill the Giant God.
^[Aquila]& End my own life? Impossible. Let humans who have trespassed this place go? Impossible.
^[Aquila]& I don't have a future like you all do.
^[Aquila]& I can't gain anything, nor can I steal anything. I can only kill some people every now and then to help vent my feelings.
|[Lucian]& So you are born to kill? What a thickhead.
^[Aquila]& This is not the first time we have had this conversation. If you are sincere, save me.
^[Aquila]& Kill me once and for all.
|[Lucian]& That's what I intend to do!!
^[Aquila]& You came without your Elemental?
^[Aquila]& You think you can take me on alone? How foolish of you.
|[Lucian]& I have always been puzzled about something..
|[Lucian]& Why did my parents leave me behind and join the fight?
|[Lucian]& .. I have always resented this.
|[Lucian]& Now I can understand.
|[Lucian]& We have a future that we cannot let you destroy.
|[Lucian]& They wanted to give me a future with freedom!
|[Lucian]& They didn't abandon me when they joined the fight!
|[Lucian]& They joined the fight because they love me!
^[Aquila]& And so? Nothing has changed. Everything is meaningless.
|[Lucian]& It's not meaningless!
|[Lucian]& Although it's just by a bit, each world has been changing gradually. I finally understand everything and I am here to defeat you.
|[Lucian]& If not for {dad&, {mom& and {Clare&, who have kept fighting, I probably wouldn't be here.
|[Lucian]& I was a fool for asking what was the point of fighting. I should have known all along.
^[Aquila]& Yawn, chat over. Time to die.
^[Aquila]& And the endless incarnation of the world will begin.
|[Lucian]& I will protect what is important and get it back from you.
|[Lucian]& That's the future for the both of us.
^[Aquila]& What...!
|[Lucian]& That's why I need you.
|[Lucian]& Remember our oath?
|[Lucian]& Come now, my sword, my shield, my other half!
|[Lucian]& {Arteli Calmon&!
^[Calmon]& Of course, wherever you are, I will be there.
^[Calmon]& I told you I can find you anywhere. I finally remember everything.
^[Aquila]& Hahaha! Are you all putting on a show?!
^[Aquila]& Alright, let's do this!
^[Aquila]& Let's see whether you can put an end to everything!!
^[Aquila]& Right about time. I am tired of waiting.
|[Lucian]& Why are you doing this! Do you crave for the power of the gods so much? What do you intend to do with it?!
^[Aquila]& This has nothing to do with the power of the gods.
|[Lucian]& What...?
^[Aquila]& Do you know the significance of my name? I am the {Protector& assigned to watch this place.
^[Aquila]& I will kill any humans that venture into this place. In other words, I can only kill humans in this place.
^[Calmon]& You lured us here in order to kill us?!
^[Aquila]& That's right. The followers of {Legolas& were all just tools.
^[Aquila]& Tools to get you to this place. Tools to make you stronger.
|[Lucian]& How many people have you killed to achieve your goals?!
^[Aquila]& You may not understand. But this world in itself is twisted.
^[Aquila]& It contains things that shouldn't have existed. Yet, things that should have existed have disappeared.
^[Aquila]& It all began with a mistake made by one man a long, long time ago.
|[Lucian]& Stop speaking in riddles!
^[Aquila]& Ok, let's fight then. If you let me be, more people will die.
^[Aquila]& For you, that is reason enough, right?
|[Lucian]& I knew long ago that there is no chance of reasoning with you.
^[Aquila]& Let's go to somewhere we can fight freely.

|[Lucian]& Posso ter ficado inconsciente, mas felizmente nao pareco estar gravemente ferido.
|[Lucian]& Voce nao tem nada para me dizer?
^[Calmon]& A pessoa que acabou de derrotar voce e um poderoso mago que surgiu entre os {Legolas& recentemente. Ele tambem e meu inimigo.
^[Calmon]& Agora voce sabe o quao forte ele e.
|[Lucian]& O que aquele sujeito tem contra voce?
^[Calmon]& Eu nao sei. Eu ja te disse antes que sou uma garota que perdeu as memorias. Nao me lembro de nada.
|[Lucian]& Deixe-me digerir isso... Os {Legolas&, por algum motivo, queriam te capturar. Por isso sao seus inimigos?
|[Lucian]& E voce, para derrota-los, precisa de um mestre para liberar suas habilidades?
^[Calmon]& Mais ou menos isso.
|[Lucian]& Entao va encontrar outro mestre. Nao quero ser arrastado para isso.
^[Calmon]& Sinto muito em te dizer, mas isso e impossivel.
^[Calmon]& Nao esqueca, nosso pacto ainda esta em vigor. Voce ouviu agora a pouco: a menos que um de nos morra, o pacto nao pode ser quebrado.
|[Lucian]& Isso e tao injusto! Nao ha como eu pagar para me livrar disso?
^[Calmon]& Este nao e um pacto qualquer. Um pacto com um Elemental e sagrado e eterno... Claro que tenho o poder de te libertar dele.
|[Lucian]& Entao, por favor, me liberte. Nao me importo, desde que tudo isso acabe.
^[Calmon]& Humpf! Acha que estou realmente dependendo de voce? Estou fazendo isso por voce. Depois de tudo, eles provavelmente sabem seu nome e seu rosto.
^[Calmon]& Em outras palavras, voce virou o alvo da recompensa deles.
^[Calmon]& Pense bem. Sem mim, acha que teria alguma chance contra eles?
|[Lucian]& Voce fala como se fosse um anjo que desceu dos ceus para me salvar... Quando na verdade, planejou tudo isso desde o inicio...
^[Calmon]& Isso nao e verdade. Embora eu admita que as coisas acabaram ficando assim.
|[Lucian]& Por que me escolheu? Fiz alguma coisa para voce nesta vida ou na anterior?
^[Calmon]& ... Eu nao sei.
|[Lucian]& Deixa para la. Nao adianta discutir isso. Me de um momento para pensar.
}Missao [Retorno 2] concluida!
|[Lucian]& Oh? {Alpez& nao vai sair? Por que?; Tem algo a dizer?
|[Lucian]& Sobre o que e?
^[Alpez]& Ela disse que precisa fazer uma viagem.; Enquanto isso, talvez queira que voce a ajude com algo...
^[Alpez]& Talvez voce precise ir a algum lugar ou coletar algo?
|[Lucian]& Argh... talvez eu deva me esconder. A mae costuma passar tarefas de quebrar as costas.
^[Alpez]& Esta falando daquela vez em que ela pediu para voce capturar um urso?
^[Alpez]& Ela provavelmente so queria treinar voce.
|[Lucian]& Qual e o sentido de treinar?
|[Lucian]& A guerra civil acabou. O unico perigo restante sao aqueles monstros ao redor da vila ou os bandidos nas colinas.
|[Lucian]& Isso pode ser facilmente resolvido pelas patrulhas.
^[Alpez]& O que? {Lucian& nao quer ficar mais forte?
|[Lucian]& Precisamos entender nossos limites. Conforme uma pessoa fica mais forte, ela tende a esquecer isso.
|[Lucian]& Entao ela quer mudar o mundo sozinha. Vai desafiar o mundo e acaba sendo morta. Nao termina sempre assim?
|[Lucian]& Uma pessoa sozinha nao e suficiente para salvar ou proteger o mundo.
^[Alpez]& Isso parece tao negativo. Voce ainda esta bravo com seus pais?
|[Lucian]& Nao exatamente. So que e dificil perdoar...
^[Alpez]& ... Hm... Digamos que exista alguem capaz de salvar o mundo sozinho?
^[Alpez]& Mas esse alguem escolhe dar as costas ao mundo por sua familia ou pelas pessoas que ama...
^[Alpez]& ... Isso nao seria imperdoavel tambem?
^[Alpez]& ... Me desculpe... Eu nao deveria ter dito isso...
|[Lucian]& Se isso for um pecado... Entao prefiro viver com isso pelo resto da minha vida.
^[Alpez]& E se {Lucian& fosse a vitima? Voce perdoaria essa pessoa?
Eu perdoaria...
Nao perdoaria.
|[Lucian]& Se voce nao consegue perdoar a pessoa so porque foi a vitima, entao esta sendo egoista, nao e?
^[Alpez]& De forma alguma!... E normal se sentir assim.
^[Alpez]& Clare vai ficar furiosa se voce demorar mais. Va falar com ela agora!
|[Lucian]& Certo!
Decidir de acordo com a situacao?
|[Lucian]& Nao da para dizer isso com certeza.; As vezes, pode ser por causa das circunstancias.
|[Lucian]& Mas por que pergunta?
^[Alpez]& Nada, so curiosidade...
|[Lucian]& Entendo. Bem, se essa pessoa fosse {Alpez&, eu perdoaria qualquer coisa.
^[Alpez]& Devo me sentir lisonjeada?; Clare vai ficar uma fera se voce demorar mais.
^[Giant God]& How can this happen! Thousands of years of waiting, a chance to finally get back at the gods!
^[Giant God]& These filthy creations, these puppets!
^[Aquila]& Finally.. It's over.
^[Calmon]& The {Protector& has vanished, {Lucian&!
|[Lucian]& {Giant God&! As you wish, the {Protector& has been defeated! Come out now!
^[Giant God]& Is it? Although I know this is a trap, I have no choice but to make an appearance.
^[Giant God]& How dare you challenge a god? Are you ready to accept punishment for your sins?
^[Calmon]& .. Now it's time for her to show up.
^[Alpez]& ...
^[Giant God]& You want to open the box? Open it and you may kill me.
^[Giant God]& But can you open it? What is inside could be hope, or it could be an even worse disaster.
^[Giant God]& You have opened it once. And you closed  it immediately because you were afraid.
^[Giant God]& Can you open it again?
^[Alpez]& I...
|[Lucian]& Open it, {Alpez&.
|[Lucian]& Even if it is a disaster, we will just deal with it.
|[Lucian]& That's how my parents and Clare lived, changing this curse of infinite incarnation bit by bit.
|[Lucian]& Even though we have been acting out a script written by this fellow, we have deviated bit by bit. That's why we are here.
|[Lucian]& All this happened for a reason! Not opening the box now will be the real sin. There is no running away now.
^[Alpez]& Eu entendo.
^[Alpez]& .. Let's end this now. I am opening the box.
^[Giant God]& Fools! Even if you attained power, you are mere creations! You think you can defeat your creator?!
^[Calmon]& It is not over yet. That is the real mastermind!
^[???]& I didn't think my wish would come true this way.. I am finally free!
^[???]& Now I can seek revenge on the gods that have imprisoned me!
|[Lucian]& Don't be so quick to rejoice!
^[???]& Get out of my sight. If you run now, I would let you go on account that you were the one who released me.
|[Lucian]& Do you think I will listen to you and walk away?
|[Lucian]& You will pay for all this!
^[???]& Hahaha! A mere mortal wants to use the weapon I made against me?
|[Lucian]& The puppet you controlled, the weapon you made.
|[Lucian]& Aside from those, there is yet another. Are you forgetting something?
|[Lucian]& This is the perfect opportunity!
^[Maskman]& I told you there would be another chance.
^[Maskman]& And you laughed at me for that, {Giant God&!
^[Maskman]& Let's put an end to this laughable story. What I can do, is to create an opportunity.
^[Maskman]& So, you must defeat him.
^[Calmon]& Don't worry about me. You just go ahead.
^[Calmon]& I wouldn't abandon you.
^[Calmon]& I will find you, just like I did before.
^[Calmon]& Nao matter where you are, I will find you.
^[Calmon]& So.. Wait for me.
|[Lucian]& Sim, I can feel you. We have repeated this cycle of waiting and reuniting too many times.

^[Aquila]& That's the reason you've been stripped of a future. The same goes for me.
^[Aquila]& The god that stole fire for man and taught them to kill and engage in war.
^[Aquila]& The {Giant God& that constantly feeds humans with forbidden knowledge that led to war after war.
^[Aquila]& .. You finally decide to appear? You detestable fellow.
^[???]& Everything will go back to the beginning. Sleep in despair and emptiness.
^[???]& If you want to protect what is important, become stronger.
